Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly introduced GLP-1 pills to compete with the in-demand weight loss shots. With Pfizer, Amgen, and Zealand Pharma developing new treatments, the weight loss market competition continues to grow rapidly to meet demand.

Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly introduced GLP-1 pills to compete with the in-demand weight loss shots. With Pfizer, Amgen, and Zealand Pharma developing new treatments, the weight loss market competition continues to grow rapidly to meet demand.
